prompt: Support wants to see how many orders a customer has placed. Add `count_for(customer_id)` to OrderService.
Finance needs a CSV export of all orders: add `export_csv(path)` to OrderService, writing one row per order with the columns order id, customer email and total in pence, plus a header row.
Customers sign in with their email address typed in any case. `CustomerService.find_by_email(email)` must find them regardless of case.
An order line with a quantity of zero or less must be rejected when the order is placed, with a ValueError.
The account page needs the customer's five most recent orders. Add a handler `recent_orders(customer_id)` in api/handlers.py returning them newest first, in the same form as `list_orders`.
Orders must show their total including 20% VAT: add `Order.total_with_vat()` returning whole pence, rounding halves up.
